# Knowledge map: QEMU sony-a6400 machine

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/qemu-a6400.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** The QEMU sony-a6400 board: captured four-core boot, av-cam and CamCore sequencing, SIO/sub-micro, display/rear panel, Ydet/CamPig, live-view frame, contributor scores, Custom OS handover guards and DMA engines.
- **Evidence span:** see record index; last reviewed 2026-11-25.
- **Deep review:** 60 of 72 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

| <a id="h02"></a>H02 | Git Bash rewrites camera paths in host commands | A host-side read of /tmp_bt/... failed because Git Bash converted the path, and the chained rm removed the helper, forcing a second /dev/mem page read. | Run camera-path commands from PowerShell or with path conversion disabled, and never chain cleanup after an unverified read. | [E0527](../evidence/0527-qemu-a6400-real-submicro-frames-power-on-holds.md) |

## Entities

### <a id="qemu-board"></a>QEMU sony-a6400 board

`qemu.board` | tool

QEMU machine for the a6400: four Cortex-A5 cores, CXD4115 tick timers, native eMMC from captured inputs, opt-in device models and a lowest-priority unmodelled catch-all.

Aliases: `qemu-a6400`, `cxd90045.unmodelled`, `CXD4115`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` QEMU boots the main nflasha3 firmware once the Sony entry contract is used (Image at 0x00108000, initrd at 0x00700000, a 'kemco'+cmdline block at 0x00103000, r1=0xDA9) and a backup.ko file_load error that cascaded into about 20 module failures is fixed. Four Cortex-A5 cores start through the pen_release handshake with SRAM mailboxes at 0xFE005010..18 (the CXD90014 pattern from Oein/a5000-emulator). The native eMMC needs 4 MiB boot0 + 4 MiB boot1 before the SDM user area and sector addressing below 2 GiB; two independent input preparations give identical hashes. ([E0521](../evidence/0521-qemu-a6400-main-firmware-boots-to-avcam.md), [E0522](../evidence/0522-qemu-a6400-smp-four-cores-and-cxd4115-timers.md), [E0524](../evidence/0524-reproducible-captured-qemu-boot-and-liro-waits.md))
- **C02** `OFFLINE` Five threads sleeping in vpool_alloc were a full UIPC realtime queue 0x13A (1,078 pending, no consumer): osal_ulogio.ko failed to load because /setting/ulogio.bin was missing. Supplying it unblocks Appframework. ([E0525](../evidence/0525-qemu-a6400-ulogio-queue-unblocks-appframework.md))
- **C11** `OFFLINE` Merged contributor PRs #35-#42 (alexscemo) report boot scores that this workspace did not re-run: read-back register files at 0xF2800000, 0xF3500000 and 0xF3880000 and the CamCore model at 0xF3010000 keep the same final sequencer state and [VPH] prefix while unmodelled pairs fall (3,065 -> 2,855 -> 2,416 for the first two); TB_JMP_CACHE_BITS 14 cuts time to the final state by about 14%; the v11 SD patch checks insertion per block instead of per byte. ([E0614](../evidence/0614-f280-clock-readback-contributor-boot-score.md), [E0615](../evidence/0615-f350-readback-contributor-boot-score.md), [E0616](../evidence/0616-tb-jmp-cache-bits-14-contributor-boot-score.md), [E0617](../evidence/0617-v11-sd-insert-check-contributor-boot-score.md), [E0618](../evidence/0618-f388-readback-contributor-boot-score.md), [E0637](../evidence/0637-camcore-f301-contributor-boot-score.md))
- **C14** `OFFLINE` Virtual SD hotplug works with the original file service, and an offline USB Mass Storage baseline exists; settings survive a fresh process after an explicit native save. ([E0650](../evidence/0650-qemu-virtual-media-gates.md))
- **C16** `OFFLINE` In the earlier no-peripheral profile Task 43's first display wait is flag 10, mask 3, pattern zero. ([E0527](../evidence/0527-qemu-task43-initialization-flag-wait.md))
- **C21** `OFFLINE` QEMU reaches the a6400 shooting screen and the step-32 wait from two public Sony updaters alone (the a6400 2019 package plus ulogio.bin from the ZV-E10 package), without the author's eMMC capture or any guest patch. ([E0665](../evidence/0665-qemu-boots-from-the-public-updater.md))
- **C22** `OFFLINE` Opt-in CXD90045 peripherals (peripherals=on, or individual touchscreen=on, bcm4339=on, hdmi-cec=on, audio-io=on, emount-lens=...) wire the FocalTech 0x20 I2C0 capacitive touch IC + GPIO P0.12 IRQ 133 + VPH LCD pointer handler (delivering paired MenuTouchFull.mod tab taps and horizontal swipes through original i2c.ko, av-cam.bin, and libObj.so I-TpMain via rear_panel.py /touch), BCM4339 SDIO Wi-Fi at mmc1 (0xF0301000, IRQ 221) and Bluetooth H4 HCI/.hcd on uart3 (/dev/ttyBT), HDMI TX (0xF2A40000 EDID/HPD/TMDS -> VPH Console 1) and CEC (0xF3C10000 virtual TV), AudioIp (0xF3420000..0xF3428FFF DMA rings + synthetic PCM mic), and Sony E-mount BL lens motors (UART1 + PL080 + P1.4), parameterized across all 8 registered camera bodies (sony-a6400, sony-a6400a, sony-zve10, sony-a6100, sony-a6600, sony-a7c, sony-a7m3, sony-a7rm4a). ([E0700](../evidence/0700-qemu-touchscreen-peripherals-and-multimodel.md))

### <a id="qemu-avcam-sequencer"></a>av-cam mode sequencer and CamCore

`qemu.avcam-sequencer` | process

av-cam's mode sequencer steps, module latches, CamCore start, Ydet statistics and the CamPig input sync path.

Aliases: `step 26`, `step 32`, `step 42`, `module 1`, `VD_Sequence`

Current knowledge:

- **C04** `OFFLINE` The ObjMic start stall was an unanswered av-cam ADF request; the ADF decode showed the missing SYSV frame clock, and with VPH timing ObjMic proceeds; the SYSV phase bit had been hidden by the clock stub. ([E0528](../evidence/0528-qemu-a6400-objmic-stall-is-unanswered-adf-micsense.md), [E0529](../evidence/0529-qemu-a6400-adf-decode-sysv-frame-clock-unblocks-objmic.md), [E0535](../evidence/0535-qemu-a6400-sysv-phase-was-hidden-by-the-clock-stub.md))
- **C07** `OFFLINE` CamCore start is gated so PowerOn never runs; the mode sequencer waits at step 12 on module 1, whose 0x0105 latch is never published; source 30 arriving before source 29 kept VD_Sequence from running. ([E0543](../evidence/0543-qemu-a6400-camcore-start-stays-gated.md), [E0544](../evidence/0544-qemu-a6400-mode-sequencer-waits-at-step-12.md), [E0549](../evidence/0549-qemu-a6400-module1-report-comes-from-0x690.md), [E0550](../evidence/0550-qemu-a6400-path-selector-already-accepted-0x3003.md), [E0551](../evidence/0551-qemu-a6400-0x690-copy-is-a-different-object.md), [E0553](../evidence/0553-qemu-a6400-module1-latch-skips-0x0105.md), [E0557](../evidence/0557-qemu-a6400-hs-root-order-passes-step-12.md))
- **C08** `OFFLINE` Module 3 holds step 32 waiting for PQD Ydet statistics (accepts 0x32E only after a per-frame counter passes 6). The Ydet adapter caller (0x63D3DD36), window configuration (0xF3015848..54) and the pending EE callback were traced; CamPig enable readback, dispatch order/input sync and Sgc1 event A are opt-in models. The 0xF3000000 handler runs on IRQ 36 after E0569 corrected the IRQ-table record alignment. ([E0561](../evidence/0561-qemu-a6400-module3-waits-on-ydet-statistics.md), [E0563](../evidence/0563-qemu-ydet-adapter-and-opd-comparison.md), [E0564](../evidence/0564-qemu-ydet-window-configuration-reaches-camcore.md), [E0565](../evidence/0565-qemu-superslow-field-and-pqd-came-dispatch.md), [E0566](../evidence/0566-qemu-ee-callback-stays-pending.md), [E0567](../evidence/0567-qemu-campig-enable-register-readback.md), [E0568](../evidence/0568-qemu-campig-dispatch-order-and-input-sync.md), [E0569](../evidence/0569-qemu-sgc1-event-a.md))
- **C10** `OFFLINE` Opt-in LIVEVIEW_SOURCE produced the first firmware-driven 640x480 live-view frame on the rear LCD (583,680 active bytes); a synthetic chart does not qualify the sensor or recording. ([E0591](../evidence/0591-qemu-a6400-first-live-view-frame.md))
- **C18** `OFFLINE` The imager was failing its own clock init before any sensor transfer: ulog RAM showed 'Leo Clkgen PLL Wait' timeouts and MIPI-Tx D-PHY init errors. Leo lock is status bit 0 at 0xFC021000 +0x50/+0x54/+0x58 after enable bits 0/4/8 of +0x000; mapping that page and the D-PHY LWAITSTAT bit lets the PLL and D-PHY lock, while the sensor writer stays idle. ([E0534](../evidence/0534-qemu-a6400-leo-pll-and-mipi-dphy-lock.md))

Do not rely on:

- ~~No caller of the Ydet producer adapter exists (negative cross-reference search).~~ **R02** `RETRACTED` ([E0561](../evidence/0561-qemu-a6400-module3-waits-on-ydet-statistics.md)); see C08: Module 3 holds step 32 waiting for PQD Ydet statistics (accepts 0x32E only after a per-frame counter passes 6). The Ydet adapter caller (0x63D3DD36), window configuration (0xF3015848..54) and the pending EE callback were traced; CamPig enable readback, dispatch order/input sync and Sgc1 event A are opt-in models. The 0xF3000000 handler runs on IRQ 36 after E0569 corrected the IRQ-table record alignment. *Note: E0563 found a direct Thumb call at 0x63D3DD36.*
- ~~The 0xF3000000 CamPig/EE handler runs on IRQ 37.~~ **R03** `RETRACTED` ([E0566](../evidence/0566-qemu-ee-callback-stays-pending.md), [E0568](../evidence/0568-qemu-campig-dispatch-order-and-input-sync.md)); see C08: Module 3 holds step 32 waiting for PQD Ydet statistics (accepts 0x32E only after a per-frame counter passes 6). The Ydet adapter caller (0x63D3DD36), window configuration (0xF3015848..54) and the pending EE callback were traced; CamPig enable readback, dispatch order/input sync and Sgc1 event A are opt-in models. The 0xF3000000 handler runs on IRQ 36 after E0569 corrected the IRQ-table record alignment. *Note: E0569 found a record alignment issue in the IRQ table; the handler runs on IRQ 36.*
- ~~The +0x690 halfword copy at 0x63988EAA is the store that keeps module 1 reporting 0x0100.~~ **R04** `RETRACTED` ([E0549](../evidence/0549-qemu-a6400-module1-report-comes-from-0x690.md)); see C07: CamCore start is gated so PowerOn never runs; the mode sequencer waits at step 12 on module 1, whose 0x0105 latch is never published; source 30 arriving before source 29 kept VD_Sequence from running. *Note: E0551: that store writes a different object; E0557 found the third writer in VD_Sequence.*

### <a id="qemu-submicro"></a>SIO, GPIO, ADC and the sub-micro link

`qemu.submicro` | device | inventory `kernel.modules:upm`

SIO/GPIO/ADC models; the sub-micro link runs on SIO channel 3; real sub-micro frames were captured once and replayed.

Aliases: `SIO ch3`, `UPM`

Current knowledge:

- **C03** `OFFLINE` SIO, GPIO and ADC models carry the sub-micro link on SIO channel 3; real a6400 sub-micro frames captured from one read-only 4 KiB /dev/mem page were replayed. ([E0526](../evidence/0526-qemu-a6400-sio-gpio-adc-and-submicro-link-buffers.md), [E0527](../evidence/0527-qemu-a6400-real-submicro-frames-power-on-holds.md))
- **C17** `OFFLINE` POWER on the a6400 is a sub-micro front key (CAkey1 bit 0, active low); the guest key table also lists active-low GPIO keys P0.3/P0.4/P0.7/P0.10/P0.11/P1.1, switch P9.22 and ADC ladders on channels 0xC/0xF/0x10/0x11. SIO (5 channels at 0xF2405000, IRQ 201+ch), GPIO (18 ports at 0xF2910000) and ADC models were ported from Oein/a5000-emulator (GPL-2.0, attributed). ([E0526](../evidence/0526-qemu-a6400-sio-gpio-adc-and-submicro-link-buffers.md))

### <a id="qemu-display"></a>Display, rear panel and viewfinder in QEMU

`qemu.display` | device

Sugilite P3D/PPF OSD drawing, YUV layer gating, EVF vs monitor layouts, rear-LCD selection, the interactive rear panel and blank-vs-disconnected detection.

Aliases: `console 0`, `FINDER`, `MONITOR`, `isOutputEvf`

Current knowledge:

- **C05** `OFFLINE` After SetContentTarget the UI render loop keeps running; Sugilite P3D/PPF draws the shooting-screen OSD while the YUV layer stays off because av-cam never writes GO to the SA DSP and the imager never starts an SA function or sensor transfer. ([E0530](../evidence/0530-qemu-a6400-post-eestart-state-and-slow-shell.md), [E0531](../evidence/0531-qemu-a6400-osd-shooting-screen.md), [E0532](../evidence/0532-qemu-a6400-sa-dsp-ids-no-go.md), [E0533](../evidence/0533-qemu-a6400-imager-never-starts-sa-or-p2s.md), [E0534](../evidence/0534-qemu-a6400-leo-pll-and-mipi-dphy-lock.md))
- **C06** `OFFLINE` Console 0 is the viewfinder readout; the eye sensor is not the a5000 hinge pin; the view asks two finder predicates; monitor layouts sit beside EVF layouts; forcing isOutputEvf false does not switch the panel skin. ([E0536](../evidence/0536-qemu-a6400-viewfinder-readout-and-eye-sensor-command.md), [E0537](../evidence/0537-qemu-a6400-eye-sensor-is-not-the-a5000-hinge.md), [E0538](../evidence/0538-qemu-a6400-finder-predicates-are-imports.md), [E0539](../evidence/0539-qemu-a6400-finder-predicate-bytes.md), [E0540](../evidence/0540-qemu-a6400-backup-bytes-do-not-change-console-0.md), [E0541](../evidence/0541-qemu-a6400-isoutputevf-does-not-switch-the-panel.md), [E0542](../evidence/0542-qemu-a6400-monitor-layouts-beside-evf.md))
- **C09** `OFFLINE` A rear-monitor selector, firmware rear-LCD rendering, an interactive rear panel and blank-vs-disconnected detection were added; stock FINDER/MONITOR selection works without a diagnostic overlay. ([E0571](../evidence/0571-qemu-a6400-rear-monitor-selector.md), [E0572](../evidence/0572-qemu-a6400-rear-lcd-layout-on-panel.md), [E0573](../evidence/0573-qemu-a6400-rear-panel-controls.md), [E0574](../evidence/0574-qemu-a6400-blank-panel-recovery.md), [E0651](../evidence/0651-qemu-a6400-stock-finder-monitor-rear-lcd.md))
- **C10** `OFFLINE` Opt-in LIVEVIEW_SOURCE produced the first firmware-driven 640x480 live-view frame on the rear LCD (583,680 active bytes); a synthetic chart does not qualify the sensor or recording. ([E0591](../evidence/0591-qemu-a6400-first-live-view-frame.md))
- **C15** `OFFLINE` Late black-screen scanout and buffers were captured; QEMU reaches the a6400 shooting screen and the step-32 wait from public updaters alone, without a camera capture. ([E0652](../evidence/0652-qemu-a6400-late-black-screen-scanout-capture.md), [E0665](../evidence/0665-qemu-boots-from-the-public-updater.md))
- **C19** `OFFLINE` The panel showed the viewfinder layout because GPIO P0.2 (the active-low EVF eye-contact sensor, KEY_OTHER_EYE_CONTACT 0x708B) was missing from the board's reset-high list; idling it high lets stock firmware select the rear-LCD layouts (LayoutST_NORMAL_WITH_INFO_LR etc.) without a diagnostic overlay. Changing the backup output-device bytes or forcing isOutputEvf did not switch the panel; isOutputEvf only moves coordinates inside a layout. ([E0536](../evidence/0536-qemu-a6400-viewfinder-readout-and-eye-sensor-command.md), [E0540](../evidence/0540-qemu-a6400-backup-bytes-do-not-change-console-0.md), [E0541](../evidence/0541-qemu-a6400-isoutputevf-does-not-switch-the-panel.md), [E0542](../evidence/0542-qemu-a6400-monitor-layouts-beside-evf.md), [E0651](../evidence/0651-qemu-a6400-stock-finder-monitor-rear-lcd.md))
- **C20** `OFFLINE` A late all-black panel is the guest's own power-save: when Power Save Start Time expires (1 min default, 10 s when selected) the firmware stops drawing and mutes VPH scanout; QEMU is not failing to show an active buffer. ([E0574](../evidence/0574-qemu-a6400-blank-panel-recovery.md), [E0652](../evidence/0652-qemu-a6400-late-black-screen-scanout-capture.md))
- **C22** `OFFLINE` Opt-in CXD90045 peripherals (peripherals=on, or individual touchscreen=on, bcm4339=on, hdmi-cec=on, audio-io=on, emount-lens=...) wire the FocalTech 0x20 I2C0 capacitive touch IC + GPIO P0.12 IRQ 133 + VPH LCD pointer handler (delivering paired MenuTouchFull.mod tab taps and horizontal swipes through original i2c.ko, av-cam.bin, and libObj.so I-TpMain via rear_panel.py /touch), BCM4339 SDIO Wi-Fi at mmc1 (0xF0301000, IRQ 221) and Bluetooth H4 HCI/.hcd on uart3 (/dev/ttyBT), HDMI TX (0xF2A40000 EDID/HPD/TMDS -> VPH Console 1) and CEC (0xF3C10000 virtual TV), AudioIp (0xF3420000..0xF3428FFF DMA rings + synthetic PCM mic), and Sony E-mount BL lens motors (UART1 + PL080 + P1.4), parameterized across all 8 registered camera bodies (sony-a6400, sony-a6400a, sony-zve10, sony-a6100, sony-a6600, sony-a7c, sony-a7m3, sony-a7rm4a). ([E0700](../evidence/0700-qemu-touchscreen-peripherals-and-multimodel.md))

### <a id="qemu-handover"></a>Custom OS handover guards and DMA engines

`qemu.handover` | process

Opt-in CXD4115 watchdog, ARMv7 cache/MMU teardown checks, DMA quiescence contracts, the work DMA engine at 0xF0102000 and the 0xF30A fill engine.

Aliases: `0xF2402000`, `0xF0102000`, `0xF30A`

Current knowledge:

- **C12** `OFFLINE` Custom OS prerequisites: an opt-in CXD4115 watchdog at 0xF2402000, cache/MMU teardown checks before a kexec-style jump, DMA quiescence contracts, the original work-DMA start/stop/busy contract at 0xF0102000 and an opt-in copy model. ([E0636](../evidence/0636-qemu-cxd4115-hardware-watchdog-opt-in.md), [E0638](../evidence/0638-qemu-handover-guard-cache-mmu-teardown.md), [E0639](../evidence/0639-qemu-handover-guard-dma-quiescence.md), [E0640](../evidence/0640-a6400-work-dma-0xf0102000-contract.md), [E0641](../evidence/0641-qemu-work-dma-copy-model-opt-in.md))
- **C13** `OFFLINE` The LIRO ram section copied by the work DMA is av-cam's own initialised RW data (1,878 references from av-cam code), not a sub-core image. ([E0644](../evidence/0644-a6400-liro-ram-section-is-avcam-data.md))

Do not rely on:

- ~~The LIRO ram section filled through 0xF30A is a separate sub-core firmware image.~~ **R01** `RETRACTED` ([E0642](../evidence/0642-a6400-f30a-fill-engine-and-liro-ram-section.md)); see C13: The LIRO ram section copied by the work DMA is av-cam's own initialised RW data (1,878 references from av-cam code), not a sub-core image.
